# History and Physical Examination (H&P)

> The comprehensive clerking and admission document that records a patient's **history** and **physical examination** at a single clinical encounter: presenting complaint and history of the presenting complaint, past medical and surgical history, drug history and allergies, family history, social history, a systems review, a full physical examination by body system, vital signs, investigations, an impression and problem list, and a management plan.
